meta.title: 30秒找到拉花不好看的原因
meta.title_en: Find Your Latte Art Flaw in 30 Seconds
meta.topic: 咖啡拉花 · 问题诊断

scenes.title_en: Pitcher Pulls Back: Pattern Stretches Thin
scenes.context: 奶缸后退，图案细长。拉花时奶缸不断后退，图案就会被拉长变细。语域：咖啡教学，诊断演示。
sentences: Pull the pitcher back and the pattern stretches thin.
Backing up too far stretches the pattern out.
这是图案不好看的原因之一。
That's one reason the art looks off.
paraphrase: 奶缸后退 → pull the pitcher back / retreat the pitcher
图案细长 → stretches thin / long and narrow
scenes.speak: Pull the pitcher back and the pattern stretches thin. Backing up too far stretches the pattern out. That's one reason the art looks off.

scenes.title_cn: 奶缸靠近中心：图案饱满
scenes.title_en: Pitcher to the Center: A Full Pattern
scenes.context: 奶缸向中心靠近，图案饱满。奶缸贴近中心点拉，图案就会饱满紧凑。语域：咖啡教学，对比诊断。
sentences: 奶缸向中心靠近，图案饱满。
Move the pitcher to the center for a full pattern.
Closer to center, the art is more compact.
The right position makes the art pretty.
paraphrase: 向中心靠近 → to the center / toward the middle
to the center · toward the middle
饱满 → full / plump and rich
scenes.speak: Move the pitcher to the center for a full pattern. Closer to center, the art is more compact. The right position makes the art pretty.

practice: Pull the pitcher back and the pattern stretches thin.
Move the pitcher to the center for a full pattern.
pitfalls: The pattern is long and thin.
Pull the pitcher back and the pattern stretches thin.
Move the pitcher to the center for a full pattern.
「向中心靠近」用 move the pitcher to the center。
That's one reason the art looks off.
Closer to center, the art is more compact.
shifts: 用 stretches thin（细长）、looks off（不好看）、a full pattern（饱满）
用 pull the pitcher back（奶缸后退）、move to the center（靠近中心）、more compact（更紧凑）
用 plump and rich（饱满）、stretched out（拉长）、pretty（好看）
